transcript.answer: Lore's web UI opens one WebSocket per browser tab to lore-api at `/api/ws` (`wss://<lore-api host>/api/ws`, configured by `LORE_WS_URL`). The socket carries JSON text frames with client-chosen channel ids. Two named channels run over it. The `run` channel forwards an assembly run's pod events and transcript. It authenticates with a token from `POST /api/assembly-runs/{id}/stream-token`. The server keeps one feed per run, fed by Postgres NOTIFY, so N viewers cost one re-read per notification. The `plan` channel tunnels the plan editor's Hocuspocus collaboration bytes to the same collab server, and the collab-token handshake stays inside the tunnel. The web-ui keeps the socket in a provider above every page, so going from a plan to its run keeps the connection. This replaced the earlier SSE stream (ADR-037, superseded by ADR-048), and the SSE route, EventSource hook and web-ui proxy were removed.
